notes.title: New Skin Available: Meet Aloy!
notes.content:
🎯 New Skin Available!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033205/8e57505e3775ab937838c86b9c1cfa496772684b.png"] 

New in the Project Arrow Demo!

We’re celebrating the Steam Next Fest with a special surprise: a new character skin, inspired by our beloved cat Aloy (yes, her name was inspired by the protagonist of Horizon Zero Dawn) 🐱🏹 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033205/55d7c063bb5f2bee7c649a2aaf10585ecf34bfd1.png"] 

Want to know more about the real Aloy?

You can learn a bit more about her in the Rewards screen, available in the game menu!

 

How to unlock it?  
To get this exclusive skin, you must earn 3 stars in every stage of the Mystic Forest.

 

Have fun!

notes.title: DEMO Patch dv 0.1.0.2
notes.content:
Update Notes – Version 0.1.0.2
 • New Features
New Character
A new skin has been added and can be unlocked by completing all objectives in the Mystic Forest.

New Laser Sound Effects
Laser shots now feature new sound effects for a more immersive experience.


• UI and Gameplay Improvements
Objectives Now Visible in the Pause Menu
You can now view tips on how to earn 3 stars directly from the pause menu during gameplay.

Alternative Keybindings Displayed in Settings 
Alternative keyboard keys are now listed in the settings menu.
• Bug Fixes
Destructible Platform Fix
The destructible platform will no longer respawn if the player is standing on it, preventing unwanted pushbacks.

D-pad Fix
Fixed an issue with the D-pad not working correctly on controllers, ensuring more precise movement.

notes.title: DEMO Patch dv 0.1.0.1
notes.content:
Update Notes

 Improved Controller Support  
You can now aim with the right analog stick without needing to hold the arrow charge button.

 Door Mechanic Adjustment  
Players no longer get stuck when a door closes on them.

 New Alternative Keyboard Controls  
We've added new keybinds for movement and jumping:  
1 - Move left/right: J / L or Left Arrow / Right Arrow  
2 - Jump: I or Up Arrow

Note – we're working on a full input customization system, allowing you to remap controls however you like.

notes.title: Project Arrow Demo is now available!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that the demo of Project Arrow is now available here on Steam! 🐱🏹
Now you can try the game for free and get a glimpse of what we’re preparing:

[previewyoutube=_h8Hv3pBw_8;full][/previewyoutube]
Project Arrow

 Run, jump, and dodge dangers.
 Use your bow and arrow physics to solve puzzles and open paths.
 Face enemies with precision and timing.
 Discover secrets and collectibles.
 There are cats. 🐱

Your feedback is super important so we can keep making the game better! So play, tell us what you think, and if you like it, don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist, it really helps the project reach more people. 💖

Thank you very much!
Have fun!
